fields.name: nationality
fields.description: Nationality: the `name` of a row of data/nationalities.csv (foreign key). The lowercase value is the folder under data/claims/.

fields.name: theater
fields.description: Primary theater of the unit (single value; claim rows carry their own theater).

fields.name: parent_unit_id
fields.description: Fixed organic parent unit, used for battle groups and combat commands (their parent division). Blank for units whose parent changes with time; use claims.parent_unit_id and claims.command_relationships for time-dependent parents.

fields.name: record_status
fields.description: How much of the unit has been researched: placeholder (identity only, no claim file), partial (claim file exists but coverage is known to be incomplete) or active (claim file exists). A placeholder is not a claim about where the unit was. Exactly the placeholders have no claim file (the validator checks this).

fields.name: formed_date
fields.description: Formation or activation date of the unit (or of the designation the record uses, see unit_note) as given by formed_date_source: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY. Blank if not known. It is not the date the unit arrived in the theater.

fields.name: formed_date_source
fields.description: URL of the page that gives formed_date. Required when formed_date is set.

fields.name: initial_parent_unit_id
fields.description: Placeholder-level hint: the formation this unit is listed under in the source named by initial_parent_source, as of initial_parent_as_of. Blank where no source clearly gives it. Not an organic-versus-attached statement and not a claim; use claims.parent_unit_id and command_relationships for that. Distinct from parent_unit_id (fixed organic parent of battle groups).

fields.name: initial_parent_as_of
fields.description: Date the listing in initial_parent_source applies to (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Required when initial_parent_unit_id is set.

fields.name: initial_parent_source
fields.description: Source token (see vocabulary source_token) for initial_parent_unit_id. Required when initial_parent_unit_id is set.

fields.name: component_of_note
fields.description: Free-text note on the placeholder parent link, for example why it is left blank or that the source lists the unit under two formations.

fields.name: unit_note
fields.description: Free-text note on the unit's identity: renames, reconstitutions, lineage caveats or uncertain Western Front service.

fields.name: listing_source
fields.description: Semicolon-separated source tokens (vocabulary source_token) naming where the unit was found when the placeholder was created. A listing is not evidence of any date or place.
